sources.detail: All 6 live pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 182-329 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = tier, entry img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster). RAID: 40/40 applied, ZERO moves. Snapshots 08-14 -> 08-15; partial because only the raid half of the source can land.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 188-324 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as this source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40/40 specs read (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), ZERO tier moves against stored - no rebuild since 2026-08-09, consistent with the Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue is still the literal upstream TBD and stays an explicit null, never omitted and never guessed (39 rated rows, floor 24). published RE-READ from each page rather than carried forward: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence. Snapshot 08-14 -> 08-15.

Both pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched (the rejected alts are the 8 Season-2 dungeon names and the site logo), ZERO tier moves against the Season-2 lists that landed yesterday. Self-dates unchanged: raid "Last Updated 10th August 2026" describing "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss", M+ 13th August opening "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2"; the M+ dungeon rows are the eight Season-2 dungeons (The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena, Ruby Life Pools, Den of Nalorakk, Altar of Fangs, King's Rest, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss). seasonVerified stays s2, so Method remains season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus in its own right and into the next-patch forecast input, with its final s1 letters already in data/season-final.json (frozenAsOf 2026-08-14) keeping the consensus composition at 4.

All 6 pages fetched with the full browser header set, HTTP 200, 73-328 KB (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Tiers parsed from the embedded [tier-list=rows] BBCode, whose closing tags are escaped as [\/...] inside a JS string. 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, 6 tier moves - ALL on the raid DPS page, which republished today: Fury Warrior B->A, Havoc DH B->A, Frost DK A->B, Arcane Mage A->B, Marksmanship Hunter A->B, Enhancement Shaman C->B. JSON-LD dateModified: raid DPS 2026-08-14 (was 2026-08-08) and raid tank 2026-08-14 (was 2026-08-08) both advanced and their stored published was updated to match; raid healer 2026-08-08, M+ DPS 2026-08-13, M+ healer 2026-08-09, M+ tank 2026-08-11 unchanged - agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD: consensus via the frozen lane, letters into the next-patch forecast).

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists[], metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping; spec read from each entry's name and matched case/space-insensitively, since Archon writes "BeastMastery Hunter" / "Havoc DemonHunter"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. 5 tier moves, ALL RAID: Frost Mage A->S, Outlaw Rogue B->A, Feral Druid A->B, Preservation Evoker B->C, Protection Warrior S->A; every M+ letter is byte-identical. THE SAMPLE COLLAPSE CONTINUES: Archon's Season-1 raid pool fell again overnight - total parses now 3992 DPS / 1041 healer / 560 tank against 6435 / 1582 / 897 in the 08-14 cut and 219704 DPS on 08-12 - so a single-night raid move here is weak evidence. The M+ pool is untouched (1.96M DPS / 661k healer / 662k tank parses). Archon's lastUpdated label still reads 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z while every raid parse count moved, which is why the parse-count column and not lastUpdated is the re-cut detector. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 (the nine S1 bosses, the eight S1 dungeons, zone label "VS / DR / MQD"), so seasonVerified stays s1 - Archon is the ONLY source still feeding the live consensus in its own right.

Full re-fetch of 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200, 0 unmatched. 83 per-encounter tier changes, ALL RAID; every M+ per-dungeon tier is byte-identical. The same S1 sample collapse leaves several role cuts publishing an EMPTY tier list upstream - Crown (all three roles; 142/38/20 parses), Chimaerus (healer 42, tank 39) and Vanguard (tank 44) - and per the standing "empty = nothing to ingest" rule those 59 stored rows were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than erased. Where a role cut DID return rows, that role is replaced wholesale, which is how the one genuine drop is recorded: Archon no longer rates Affliction Warlock on Vanguard. File now holds 677 tier rows (was 678, floor 440). asOf set to Archon's own cut date 2026-08-14, never the run date.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, merged at Archon's cut date 2026-08-14. ZERO tiers moved this run, against 18 last night. Same caveat as the throughput list: the raid sample behind these tiers has now fallen to 3992/1041/560 parses, so quiet is not the same as settled.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, each with n = that spec's parse count. A genuine new cut - 29 of 33 values moved (largest, Outlaw Rogue 169079 -> 180395, +6.7%, well inside the 60% value-move guard) and every parse count fell again with the shrinking Season-1 pool (Devourer DH 602, Unholy DK ~500-scale). PARTIAL, not success: Archon's own cut label is still 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z, so the merge keeps asOf 2026-08-14 and the family's coverage date does not advance - stamping today would be exactly the re-stamp the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf rule forbids. The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses; all seven values and parse counts moved with the new cut and were merged at Archon's own date 2026-08-14, so the stored date is unchanged and this is partial rather than success for the same reason as archon-metrics. Emitted as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never be hidden by the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column: 40/40 specs parsed cleanly, and all 40 scores AND all 40 parse counts are byte-identical to stored for the fifth consecutive run - the M+ cut has not re-run since 2026-08-10 even though the page label reads 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z. Nothing was merged; the rows stay at 2026-08-10, which is now 5 days against maxAgeDays 5, so the heartbeat alarms tomorrow if Archon still has not re-cut its M+ numbers. That red would be the honest signal, not a defect on our side.

80 rows parsed (40 raid + 40 M+) from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention. The RAID half moved with the new cut (32 of 40 values changed) and was merged at Archon's date 2026-08-14; the M+ half is byte-identical to stored - same parse counts, same fractions - and was deliberately left alone rather than re-stamped. The family's coverage date is therefore the unchanged M+ half at 2026-08-10 (the probe takes the 60th-freshest of 80 rows), which is what previousAsOf/newAsOf report and why this is partial.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, plain curl, HTTP 200. Selected categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined - a WHITELIST, so the melee/ranged subsets cannot double-count the 27 DPS specs - giving exactly 27+7+6 = 40 rows with classSpec names byte-identical to the roster. UPSTREAM STILL HAS NOT RE-RUN: manifest.snapshotDate is 2026-08-11 for the fourth day (pipeline completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z, unchanged) and all 40 lowerBound values plus all 40 numberOfCharacters reproduce the stored rows exactly. asOf is the source's snapshotDate and never today, so nothing was merged; stored data stays at 2026-08-11 (4 days, maxAgeDays 8).

All three meta pages (dps/healer/tank M+) fetched by plain GET, HTTP 200, 41-71 KB - never r.jina.ai, which does not work on murlok. Parsed by splitting on <a> tags and testing for meta-item anywhere in the tag, because murlok's attribute order is not stable; the tell that it parsed cleanly is that the rank column is contiguous 1..27 / 1..7 / 1..6, and it is. 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, and every one of the 40 "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" values is again unchanged from stored - the Season-1 M+ ladder is finished, so the top-50 ceilings are frozen in place and will stay so until Season 2 opens on 08-18. Murlok publishes no self-date and no cut identity (the page states only "updated every 8 hours with live data"), so the fetch date IS the only honest observation date and the live re-read is stamped 2026-08-15.

BLOODMALLET HAS RETIRED THE MID1 CHARTS AND THE MID2 SET IS STILL INCOMPLETE - nothing could honestly be ingested, third consecutive night, and the picture is byte-for-byte the same as last night. All 27 DPS specs requested from talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 4 retries each: the SAME 14 returned charts and every one is simc_settings.tier == "MID2" re-simmed 2026-08-12; the SAME 13 (Havoc + Devourer DH, Balance + Feral Druid, Augmentation + Devastation Evoker, Windwalker Monk, Retribution Paladin, Assassination + Outlaw Rogue, Demonology Warlock, Arms + Fury Warrior) returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on all four tries. Merging 14 MID2 charts alongside 12 stored MID1 profiles would mix two sim tiers inside the within-role percentile labels the build derives from fightProfile, so the stored MID1 profiles are untouched at 2026-07-08 (38 days, maxAgeDays 5 - the heartbeat going red IS the honest signal). OWNER DECISION PENDING: adopt MID2 wholesale once bloodmallet has re-simmed the full DPS roster.

MID1_Raid.html re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 37.2 MB. Its own header still reads "Timestamp: 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000", SimulationCraft 1205-01 for World of Warcraft 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, git 678e66d384) - the same completed report as the last seven runs, so there is no re-sim to ingest. Verified rather than assumed: all 26 stored "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" values reproduce EXACTLY out of today's copy, taking the best variant per spec from the FIRST chart data block (the later blocks are the burst/DTPS/priority charts and carry different quantities - matching on player name alone across all blocks silently reads the wrong chart and returns roughly 2.2x the right number). Stored rows stay at 2026-08-08 (7 days, maxAgeDays 10). Note the report is still simming 12.0.7, four days after 12.1 shipped.

Fetched DIRECTLY, HTTP 200, 185 KB (/period/latest 302s to /period/1075; r.jina.ai was not needed). Still period 1075, week 20 of MID1, top 2000 keys / 10000 characters (2863 unique), 22.6 average key level - no new weekly period, as expected with Season 1 finished and Season 2 opening 08-18. 34 spec bars parsed from the "Spec representation in top keys" figure by the img title attribute (the visible bar label carries only the number), and ALL 34 are byte-identical to stored, against 15 that moved last night. Unlike murlok, this source publishes a cut IDENTITY (the period id): an unchanged period plus unchanged values is the same cut, so nothing was merged and nothing was re-stamped - the rows stay at 2026-08-14 (1 day). Six specs remain absent from the figure upstream (Vengeance DH, Restoration Druid, Devastation Evoker, Protection Paladin, Holy Priest, Protection Warrior) and keep their older dates.

A NEW ENTRY WAS LOGGED - the feed goes 15 -> 16 entries, newest now 2026-08-15. All three channels checked. (1) Official dev-notes thread 2317811.json: posts_count 17, highest_post_number still 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31T23:42Z) - closed for this cycle. (2) Wowhead news RSS, 40 items spanning 2026-08-11..08-14, bodies read out of content:encoded in a single fetch. (3) Forum search surfaced the real source: "Class Tuning Incoming - August 18" (Linxy, topic 2336820, 2026-08-15T00:11Z) - the Season 2 launch tuning pass, a STANDALONE official forum topic rather than a reply in the tracked thread, so it is logged kind "build" citing that topic (post 1) with the Wowhead mirror alongside, and the feed's `thread` key is unchanged. 14 specs distilled as one consolidated line each (Blood + Frost DK, Devourer DH, Restoration Druid, Beast Mastery Hunter, Arcane Mage, Mistweaver Monk, Discipline + Holy Priest, Assassination + Subtlety Rogue, Enhancement Shaman, Demonology Warlock, Fury Warrior); the coverage gate agrees specsAffected and highlights 14/14. EIGHT Season-2 tier sets were revised by that post and spec.tierSet was updated for each in the same edit (Frost DK, Devourer DH, BM Hunter, Arcane Mage, Mistweaver, Subtlety, Demonology, Fury) - values swapped into the stored wording where the notes give a clean swap, and a dated parenthetical where they do not (Arcane's uncapped restatement, Mistweaver's relative activation-rate change, and Demonology's, where Blizzard's post calls the Implode effect the 2-SET while our datamine and the 07-31 notes placed it on the 4-set: the values were updated where the effect is stored rather than moved on one post's say-so). The post's PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER section is out of scope for this PvE tracker and was deliberately NOT distilled - it is the only place Fire Mage, Retribution Paladin, Restoration Shaman and Destruction Warlock appear, and the Fire Mage set-bonus line there is PvP-only. Also checked and NOT logged: the Aug-13 and Aug-14 live hotfix round-ups (bug fixes plus trinket/item tuning, no spec tuning), "Season 2 Trinket Tuning Now Live", and the 08-12 tuning roadmap (already recorded; first pass 08-18, then 08-25 / 09-01 / 09-22). "Patch 12.1.5 PTR Now Listed on Battle.net Launcher" (08-13) still stands as the tip-off that the NEXT cycle will need a new forum thread and a re-pointed `thread` key; nothing is datamined yet. Writeup coverage recomputed, not read: 39/40, Demonology Warlock's null deliberate. Zone 54/52/56 are evidence-only for this agent and are reported under their own WCL keys. KNOWN CONSEQUENCE, LEFT FOR A LOCAL RUN: those eight tierSet edits make `check-refresh --age` report gearing-tierset-sync (8 specs carrying tier-set text the tracker has since corrected). That is the check working as designed - it measures wrongness, not age - but the fix is `node gearing/src/sync-tracker-fields.mjs` + `npm run gearing:build` under gearing/, which the nightly publish job does not stage (it stages only data/, dist/ and skill logs), so running it here would orphan the edit and could publish an unbuilt template. It does NOT affect this run: the gearing block is a sibling of requirements[], so npm test and the publish gate stay green and only the heartbeat alarms.

TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. transcript-fetch/summary.json (2026-08-15T04:58:38Z) reports verdict "limit-exceeded" on the single video it attempted (bqVHzvKJCuA), 1 requested / 0 fetched, "remaining queue untouched" - Supadata's free tier is 100 requests per MONTH and the budget is spent, second night running. No transcript was readable, so ZERO takes and ZERO metaNotes were added, changed or superseded, and this agent fetched no transcript from YouTube or any transcript API by any means. DISCOVERY IS ALSO DEGRADED TONIGHT AND THAT IS NEW: the public RSS endpoint (youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml) 404s from this runner for 40 of 44 channels and did not clear across four rounds with backoff over ~10 minutes - not the documented transient burst. Discovery was completed instead with the preinstalled yt-dlp at its requirements.txt pin (2026.07.04, never installed or upgraded in-run), --flat-playlist over each channel's /videos tab, newest 15 per channel: 44/44 channels enumerated, 0 failures, 652 videos, seen-set rebuilt from the four structured lanes (1011 ids). 134 unseen; 31 date at or after the 12.1 cycle's opening build (2026-06-18). 16 were queued under the nightly keyword filter - six same-day reactions to tonight's Aug-18 tuning post (Shadarek on the Devourer tier set, Nintern on Devourer, MadSkillzzTV on healer buffs/nerfs, Preheat on Arcane, Supatease, Dratnos) plus ten older 12.1/Season-2 spec pieces from MadSkillzzTV, AutomaticJak, Megasett, Shindigg, Musguete and Bansherz. Queue now 43, draining when the monthly budget resets or in a local run. ONE CAVEAT RECORDED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER: yt-dlp's approximate_date is day-precise only for recent uploads and rounds older ones to the middle of the month, so NO discovery-time dismissal was written to seen[] this run - the 103 apparently pre-cycle videos stay unexamined and will be reconsidered next run rather than being permanently retired on an approximate date. Coverage recomputed: every spec holds at least one live take; Brewmaster Monk is still the only spec with no RAID-scoped one.
